Planning a mobility for your institution

For Erasmus+ coordinators, school leadership and institutions arranging mobility for their staff or students. Tell us the project, and the Barcelona team builds and runs the Spanish part.

Tell us about the project Hola@SpainBcn.com

Wherever the project stands

You have an approved project

We act as the receiving partner in Spain: we run the programme, confirm every arrangement in writing, and provide the documents your grant administration needs.

You are still preparing it

We provide the course descriptions and pre-registration documents your application needs, and confirm dates and fees in writing, so you can plan the Spanish part before you submit.

What we can organise

  • Scheduled course weeks your staff join
  • Private course weeks for one institution
  • Tailored training, with subject areas combined
  • Programmes for student groups
  • Job shadowing placements
  • Educational visits

Need a different format? Tell us what your project requires.

Documents we provide

For Erasmus+ staff mobility. SpainBcn-Programs · Erasmus+ OID E10336106

  • Invitation letterFor grant agreements and travel.
  • Pre-registration confirmationFor KA1 applications.
  • Acceptance letterWhen a participant signs up and confirms, if their institution needs one.
  • Course description and programmeWith the contact hours and what the week covers.
  • Certificate of attendanceIssued on the final day.
  • Europass Mobility supportCourse information, dates and confirmation.
  • InvoiceFor your grant records.

In the EU participant portal we are registered as SPAINBCN-PROGRAMS IN BARCELONA S.L.

Fees and invoicing

Course fees are per person and are published on each subject-area page. A private programme or a group project is quoted for the group: tell us the group and we confirm the fee and the invoicing in writing before you commit.

Travel, accommodation and meals are not part of the fee. Under Erasmus+ they come from the grant's own budget lines.

Where the programme runs

Barcelona is the base: the office is in Gràcia, five minutes on foot from the Sagrada Família, and classes also run at Barceloneta.

Depending on the group and the dates, a project can also run at SpainBcn's other Spanish destinations — see locations ↗.

Tell us what your project needs

The group, the objectives and the dates you have in mind. Asking is not a commitment. A real person replies within two working days, usually sooner.
